comment: Fungus s3003 gi148 T3 (regression d5): under Concordant Crossroads the hasted Undercellar Myconid is a same-turn producer, which brings {Wild Growth -> Forest, Myconid} into the payable-order walk. The walk ignored Wild Growth's bonus, read the given order (Wild Growth first: Woodlot pays it, Forest + the bonus pay the Myconid) as unpayable and moved the Myconid first, so it tapped itself for Wild Growth and missed the attack: T5 instead of T4. MTG_PO_LAND_AURA_HOLD holds the host back until a cast needs it (ManaPayment.cpp PoLandAuraHoldFor).
